# Atlas

> Atlas (travel.6x7.gr) is a free web app, an AI travel companion by 6x7. Show it a photo and it identifies the place, then helps plan the whole trip.

## What it does
- Identify a place from a photo and get an itinerary for it
- Compare flights and bookings
- Visa and entry requirements by passport and destination
- Airport guides (gates, transfers, lounges)
- Live phrase translation
- Local tips and common scams to avoid
- A private document vault and trip journal (sign-in required)
